description: A single filled area drawn as steps, holding each value flat until the next reading.
overview: A single filled area drawn as steps that hold each value flat until the next reading. It suits values that change in discrete jumps, like prices, plan tiers or inventory counts.
usage: Replace `chartData`, point each `dataKey` at your fields and set the label and color in `chartConfig`. Switch the curve type to `stepAfter` or `stepBefore` if you want the jump on a different side of each point.
notes: The plot supports keyboard navigation: focus it and use the arrow keys to move between months.
